cases.objective: Verify that the update screen shows the correct title, subtitle, and progress bar when a forced OTA update is triggered
cases.precondition: A newer app version is available server-side and the app is configured to force update

steps.expected_result: The 'Updating your app...' screen appears with subtitle 'This will only take a moment.' and a visible progress bar
Progress bar is partially filled (dark blue fill on left, grey remainder on right) and visually advances over time

cases.title: Update screen displays correctly on app launch

cases.objective: Verify that the progress bar reaches 100% and the app automatically transitions to the next screen after a successful update
cases.precondition: Force update screen is displayed and device has a stable internet connection

steps.expected_result: Progress bar fills fully from left to right
steps.step: Wait for the update to download and install

steps.expected_result: App navigates away from the update screen to the normal app flow (e.g., home or login screen)
steps.step: Observe the screen after the bar completes

cases.title: Progress bar advances to completion and app navigates forward

cases.objective: Verify that no interactive elements are available to the user while the forced update is in progress

steps.expected_result: No interactive response; screen remains on the update progress view
steps.step: Attempt to tap anywhere on the update screen

steps.expected_result: Screen cannot be dismissed; update continues uninterrupted
steps.step: Attempt to swipe down or use gestures to dismiss

cases.title: Update screen blocks user interaction during update

cases.objective: Verify the app handles network loss gracefully during a forced OTA update
cases.precondition: Force update screen is visible and update is in progress

steps.step: Turn off Wi-Fi and cellular data on the device while the update is in progress

steps.expected_result: An appropriate error message or retry prompt is displayed informing the user of the connectivity issue

cases.title: Update interrupted by loss of internet connection

cases.objective: Verify the app can resume or retry the OTA update after a temporary network interruption
cases.precondition: Network was lost during update causing it to stop

steps.expected_result: Update resumes or restarts automatically and progress bar advances again without requiring manual app restart

cases.title: Update resumes or retries after connectivity is restored

cases.objective: Verify that the app cannot be used and always shows the update screen if the update has not yet completed
cases.precondition: User backgrounds or force-quits the app while update is in progress

steps.step: Background the app during the update

steps.expected_result: The 'Updating your app...' screen is shown again and update continues or restarts

cases.title: Force update screen appears on every launch until update completes

cases.execution_comment: if crash happens, it rolls back to previous version
cases.objective: Verify the app handles a corrupted or invalid update payload gracefully
cases.precondition: Server is configured to serve a corrupted update bundle; force update is triggered

steps.expected_result: Update screen appears and progress bar begins moving
steps.step: Launch the app so it triggers the forced update

steps.expected_result: An error message is shown; app does not crash and does not navigate to main content
steps.step: Wait for the download to complete and installation to fail

cases.title: Update screen displayed when server returns corrupted update package

cases.objective: Verify that the update screen does not display when the app version matches the server's required minimum version
cases.precondition: App is already on the latest required version; no forced update is pending

steps.expected_result: The 'Updating your app...' screen is NOT shown; app proceeds directly to normal flow

cases.title: No update available - update screen should not appear

cases.objective: Verify the update screen renders correctly and update continues when device orientation changes
cases.precondition: Force update screen is visible and update is in progress

steps.expected_result: UI reflows correctly; title, subtitle, and progress bar are all visible and properly laid out
steps.step: Rotate the device to landscape orientation

steps.expected_result: UI returns to portrait layout without any visual glitches and progress bar continues advancing

cases.title: Update screen orientation change during progress
